## Binding SCI-JINC Extension

For SCI-JINC, the owner-approved successor rule is:

- PTC owns one versioned registry of positive analysis/gridding coefficient
  families;
- each exact family/version declares permission for named consumers
  `SCI-MAP`, `SCI-JINC`, or both;
- MAP permission never implies JINC permission, and JINC permission never
  implies MAP permission;
- the user selects from the exact allowed family list, or an explicit
  versioned mode policy supplies a default;
- requested, effective, observation-resolved and realized family identity are
  distinct and retained;
- for a JINC-permitted family, JINC consumes the same positive PTC-produced
  `omega_i` with separately typed availability/QC, identity, normalization,
  support, provenance and covariance meaning;
- JINC alone applies `kappa_ip` and owns signed
  `w_ip=kappa_ip omega_i`, normalization, conditioning, support and fixed
  JINC bundle semantics; response and covariance remain JINC-owned questions
  if a later concrete scientific use authorizes those products, but neither is
  a base-v0.1 role under ODQ-107; and
- missing selection without an authorized default, an unregistered family,
  absent JINC permission, or unavailable/mismatched payload makes the affected
  route unavailable with no hidden unity or alternate-family fallback.

This JINC extension supersedes only the predecessor source's MAP-facing scope
wording for the SCI-JINC successor. It does not promote a candidate discovery
seed to a registered family and does not establish inverse-variance,
precision, sensitivity or significance meaning.
